question.prompt:

Answer in the language of the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (VRI) edition.

expected.text: Asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha; Saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca; Sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkhamidaṃ anappakaṃ.

answer: Meditate, O bhikkhu, be not heedless! Let not your mind whirl in the strand of sensuality! Do not, being heedless, swallow a ball of heated iron! Do not cry out "This is suffering" when you are burning!
